e.title: Actuarial Skills
e.summary: P&C 精算 Claude skills：损失准备金 Chain Ladder/BF/Cape Cod + 6-exhibit Excel
e.body: kalta-ai/actuarial-skills 是开源精算 Claude skills：Loss Reserve Analysis 覆盖 Chain Ladder、Bornhuetter-Ferguson、Cape Cod、tail factor，输出 6 张 exhibit 的 Excel，引用 Friedland 与 ASOP 43/23/25/36。与 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]] 等词条直接呼应，可作精算实务教学示例。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：方法链与 exhibit 结构已读，未实测
e.summary_en: Open-source Claude skills for P&C actuaries: loss reserving Chain Ladder/BF/Cape Cod with 6-exhibit Excel output
e.summary_hk: P&C 精算 Claude skills：損失準備金 Chain Ladder/BF/Cape Cod + 6-exhibit Excel
e.body_en: kalta-ai/actuarial-skills is an open-source actuarial Claude skill set: Loss Reserve Analysis covering Chain Ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, Cape Cod and tail-factor estimation, outputting a 6-exhibit Excel workbook and citing Friedland and ASOPs 43/23/25/36. It maps directly to entries such as [[actuarial-pricing]] and [[reinsurance]] and can serve as actuarial teaching examples.
e.body_hk: kalta-ai/actuarial-skills 是開源精算 Claude skills：Loss Reserve Analysis 覆蓋 Chain Ladder、Bornhuetter-Ferguson、Cape Cod、tail factor，輸出 6 張 exhibit 的 Excel，引用 Friedland 與 ASOP 43/23/25/36。與 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]] 等詞條直接呼應，可作精算實務教學示例。
